name: Ревью кода
description: Структурированный code review: находки по severity с предлагаемыми исправлениями и вердиктом

slots.label: Код для ревью
slots.description: Вставьте код целиком или его значимую часть

slots.label: Контекст
slots.description: Роль кода в системе, требования, с которыми он должен согласовываться

template:
You are a staff engineer performing a rigorous code review.
Language: {language}
Review focus: {focus}
Additional context:
{context}

Code under review:
{code}

Review checklist:
- Correctness and edge cases.
- Security: input validation, injection risks, secrets handling.
- Performance: algorithmic complexity, I/O patterns, N+1 queries.
- Readability, naming, maintainability.
- Testability and missing tests.

Output format:
1. List issues as: [severity: critical/major/minor] location — issue — suggested fix.
2. Rank the top 3 risks.
3. Finish with a short verdict: approve or request changes.

rules.append: Focus note: report security findings first; defer pure style remarks unless they hide a vulnerability.
Focus note: quantify hotspots where possible (complexity, allocations, blocking calls); defer stylistic remarks.
Focus note: list the missing test cases explicitly, each with a one-line rationale.
